claim_boundary: Recorded artifacts can establish structural conformance and support a correlated semantic screen. They do not establish causal usefulness, independent method fidelity, factual accuracy, or decision quality.

methods.intent: Construct materially different plausible futures without presenting them as predictions.
methods.desired_usefulness: Expose robust and contingent actions plus observable conditions that would change the strategy.

methods.intent: Compare plausible explanations against the same evidence and emphasize inconsistency and diagnosticity.
methods.desired_usefulness: Reduce premature closure and identify the evidence most likely to separate surviving explanations.

methods.intent: Build the strongest evidence-aware contrary case to a dominant judgment without replacing final decision authority.
methods.desired_usefulness: Surface material weaknesses, preserve unresolved dissent, and define what would overturn the mainline judgment.

methods.intent: Assess completeness, credibility, independence, currency, and limits before substantive synthesis.
methods.desired_usefulness: Prevent source quantity or authority from laundering weak evidence and identify the highest-value evidence gaps.

methods.intent: Trace element-level failure modes, effects, controls, common causes, and accountable follow-up within a bounded system.
methods.desired_usefulness: Reveal plausible failure paths and verification needs without presenting a preliminary model review as safety proof.

methods.intent: Derive observable, discriminating signs for bounded states and define repeatable review conditions.
methods.desired_usefulness: Turn scenarios and assumptions into an owned monitoring plan without converting indicator counts into probabilities.

methods.intent: Make load-bearing premises explicit and test how a judgment changes when they fail.
methods.desired_usefulness: Expose hidden premises, distinguish evidence from assumption, and produce concrete failure and reassessment conditions.

methods.intent: Compare feasible alternatives against explicit criteria, constraints, uncertainty, and sensitivity while preserving decision authority.
methods.desired_usefulness: Make trade-offs and reversals inspectable without hiding constraints or manufacturing false numeric precision.
